Author.description: Null unless the caller wrote the design or voted on it.

reply.description: The planner reply. Left out, any earlier reply stays.

CommentResult.description: 'updated' when the caller already had an open comment of this kind on the element.

ContextFeature.description: A street, sidewalk, bus stop, stall or bikeway.

ContextGeometry.description: Local metres from the parcel box minimum; context reaches past the parcel.

seed.description: Layout seed for describe; the same text and seed give the same draft.

sourceDesignId.description: The submitted design to fork; required when from is fork.

text.description: What the park should have; required when from is describe.

closesAt.description: Last day of design and voting in Vancouver time, as an ISO date.

zones.description: Zones drawn in setup; added to parameters.forbiddenZones.

updatedAt.description: The server stamp of the last save. Send it back as expectedUpdatedAt; compare it only for equality.

DesignLineage.description: Where a design came from and what replaced it.

DraftChanged.description: Someone saved this draft after the stamp the caller sent; current is that save.

ElementCommentGroup.description: One element and its comments, oldest first. Counts leave out hidden comments.

editable.description: True while the caller may still edit it: their own, open phase, 15 minutes.

mine.description: True when the caller wrote the comment.

ElementFeedback.description: Comments that are not hidden, per design, most commented first.

GeoJsonPolygon.description: A GeoJSON Polygon in WGS84; ring 0 is the outline.

HardFailure.description: A broken hard constraint that blocks submitting.

values.description: Share of designs covering each cell, row by row from the south-west corner.

Insights.description: What residents built and said, for planners. Groups under 5 people are hidden.

suppressed.description: True when fewer than 5 people are in the group.
True when fewer than 5 people are in the group.

text.example: a dog park in the back corner, a pond on the low side, lots of trees

accessCode.description: The staff access code. Staff personas need it when staffCodeRequired is true.

MyVote.description: The caller's vote on a design, or null when they have not voted.

NewComment.description: The element and the kind of comment. The server reads the element kind and category from the design.

surfacePoint.description: Where on a path or area the person tapped, in local metres. Dropped on items.

text.description: Plain text, trimmed, at most 280 characters and no HTML tags. Left out, the kind alone is the comment.
text.example: Face the bench toward the playground.

staffCodeRequired.description: True when staff personas need the access code to log in.

closesAt.description: Last day of design and voting in Vancouver time, as an ISO date.

phase.description: closed when staff closed the project or its closing day has passed.

closesAt.description: A new closing day; null clears it, and leaving it out keeps it.

ProjectTerrain.description: The ground the 3D views draw and metrics use.

elevations.description: Elevations in metres as base64 float32 little-endian, south row first.

source.description: flat when the project has no stored heightmap yet.

ProposedFeature.description: An existing thing on the site, in local metres.

QueuePoster.description: The first design picture, so the page can start loading it at once.

placeholder.description: A solid colour to show until it loads.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The updatedAt the caller last read. When it no longer matches, nothing is saved and the answer is 409 DraftChanged.

SelfReport.description: The first 3 characters of a postal code and an age band. Both are optional.

SiteContext.description: What lies within bufferM of the parcel box, sorted by layer and then id.

SoftWarning.description: A missed soft constraint, shown as a badge.

thumbnailPending.description: True while the design has no stored thumbnail. Upload one with POST /designs/{id}/thumbnail, and retry after Retry-After if it answers 503.

SurfacePoint.description: Where on a path or area the person tapped, in local metres.

TerrainProviderName.description: The provider that supplied the elevations.

image.description: Base64-encoded WebP, or PNG where WebP is not supported; 500 KB at most.

comment.description: The voter's own words in plain text, trimmed, at most 500 characters and no HTML tags. Blank or left out, the vote has no comment.
comment.example: Keep the garden plots by the lane.

VoteChange.description: The whole vote: a change to the value, the reasons or the comment replaces all 3.

comment.example: Keep the garden plots by the lane.

VoteComments.description: What voters wrote with their votes, newest first, under each live design.

WithdrawResult.description: 'absent' when the caller had no vote on the design, so nothing changed.
